title: Cerium-oxo clusters for photocatalytic aerobic oxygenation of sulfides to sulfoxides

material_class.structural_family: Spherical cerium-oxo carboxylate cluster with a fluorite-like core

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate, isonicotinic acid and ammonium iodide in aqueous pyridine (10:1 v/v; 2.2 mL). Stir for 30 minutes, add acetonitrile (4 mL), then leave the mixture undisturbed in a 10 mL glass vial for 1 week. Collect the resulting yellow square crystals and dry them in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Self-assembly and undisturbed crystallization in a 10 mL glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow square crystals were collected and dried in air.

properties.summary: Broad UV–visible absorption with a peak at 385 nm. The reported Tauc-plot band gap is 2.46 eV. Under 365 nm irradiation, the cluster also showed photocatalytic aerobic oxidation of sulfides to sulfoxides.

measurements.name: Optical band gap from Tauc plot

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row for QEJGAR

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The spherical Ce16 core has four cerium layers in a 2:6:6:2 arrangement. Its cubic Ce(IV) and tetrahedral oxide coordination motifs resemble fluorite CeO2.

material_class.structural_family: Spherical mixed-valence cerium-oxo carboxylate cluster with a fluorite-like core

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve ammonium cerium(IV) nitrate, 2-thiophenecarboxylic acid and ammonium iodide in aqueous pyridine (20:1 v/v; 2.1 mL). Stir for 30 minutes, add acetonitrile (2 mL), then leave the mixture undisturbed in a 10 mL glass vial for 2 weeks. Collect the resulting yellow hexagonal crystals and dry them in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Self-assembly and undisturbed crystallization in a 10 mL glass vial
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow hexagonal crystals were collected and dried in air.

properties.summary: Broad UV–visible absorption with a peak at 405 nm. The reported Tauc-plot band gap is 2.05 eV. The cluster was also tested for photocatalytic aerobic sulfide oxidation under 365 nm irradiation.

measurements.name: Optical band gap from Tauc plot

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row for QEJGEV

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Ce24 cluster comprises 22 Ce(IV) and two Ce(III) ions in five cerium layers arranged 2:6:8:6:2. The two Ce(III) ions lie at opposite ends of the inner Ce22(IV) core, which contains fluorite-like cerium–oxide coordination motifs.
